_comment: Certified rows at values of A that are NOT in Chirre-Quesada-Herrera Table 1, so they are kept out of final_table.json and its 68-row statistics. verify_all.py certifies these too and reports them separately.

rows.record_source: Chirre, Pereira Junior, de Laat, Math. Comp. 90 (2021) 2235-2246, Section 1.3: 'We get C+(36/11) >= 1.1965'
rows.why: 36/11 is the A behind the ordinary-prime gap constant under RH. The constant is 1/C_+(36/11); CPdL state 0.8358.
rows.note: B = 33/10, found by sweeping the bandwidth; the LP beat the SDP here (SDP best was 1.1987613458 at d=36, c=0.65).
